scenes.description: IT DOES NOT MEMORIZE — A neural network does not memorize answers. It guesses, measures how wrong it is, and nudges millions of tiny knobs.
scenes.information_role: A neural network does not memorize answers. It guesses, measures how wrong it is, and nudges millions of tiny knobs.

scenes.description: WEIGHTS ARE THE KNOBS — Those knobs are weights. Each connection multiplies a signal. Stack enough of them and you get a guess.
scenes.information_role: Those knobs are weights. Each connection multiplies a signal. Stack enough of them and you get a guess.

scenes.description: FORWARD PASS — First the signal runs forward. Pixels in, scores out. That is the forward pass.
scenes.information_role: First the signal runs forward. Pixels in, scores out. That is the forward pass.

scenes.description: LOSS IS A NUMBER — Then a loss function scores the miss. If the label is cat and the network said dog, the error is a number — not a lecture.
scenes.information_role: Then a loss function scores the miss. If the label is cat and the network said dog, the error is a number — not a lecture.

scenes.description: THE ERROR WALKS BACK — Backpropagation sends that error backward. Every weight gets a tiny update: a little more this way, a little less that way.
scenes.information_role: Backpropagation sends that error backward. Every weight gets a tiny update: a little more this way, a little less that way.

scenes.description: THAT IS LEARNING — Do that millions of times, and the guesses get less wrong. That is learning.
scenes.information_role: Do that millions of times, and the guesses get less wrong. That is learning.
